::: {#cor-logistic-wald}

#### Wald interval for a logistic coefficient

Let $\hat W$ be $W$ with each $\prob_i$ replaced by its fitted value.
The estimated standard error of $\hcoef{j}$ is the square root of the $j$th diagonal entry of $\inv{\tp{X} \hat W X}$,
and a [Wald confidence interval](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-wald-ci) with level $1 - \siglevel$ for $\coef{j}$ is

$$
\hcoef{j} \pm z_{1 - \siglevel/2} \, \hse{\hcoef{j}}.
$$

:::
